fuente.titulo: Pope Leo to visit Assisi 40 years after historic prayer meeting

titular: Pope Leo to join Assisi peace prayer
bajada: 40th interreligious gathering in Assisi, continuing a tradition started by John Paul II
caption: Pope Leo XIV will travel to Assisi from October 25-27 for the 40th annual interreligious peace prayer meeting, a tradition begun by Pope St John Paul II in 1986. Source: Vatican News, Oct 6, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: The Basilica of St Francis in Assisi at dusk, with doves flying near its facade; a robed pontifical figure walks toward the entrance, placed in the upper right third, left and center open.
